profile.headline: AI Solution Architect | Generative AI, Agentic AI amp; RAG | Lead Software Engineer | Cloud amp; Distributed Systems | AWS, Azure, GCP | Air Force Veteran
profile.summary: I’m an Artificial Intelligence Solution Architect and Lead Software Engineer with over a decade of experience designing and delivering enterprise AI, cloud, distributed, and full-stack solutions.My current work focuses on generative AI, agentic systems, RAG, conversational AI, real-time voice capabilities, and scalable AI platforms. I work across architecture and hands-on engineering, translating complex business and technical requirements into production-ready solutions spanning frontend applications, backend services, APIs, data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and observability.Throughout my career, I’ve designed and built high-scale distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native applications, and enterprise platforms using technologies including Java, Python, React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, and GCP.I enjoy solving complex technical problems, evaluating emerging AI technologies, mentoring engineers, and helping teams turn ideas into reliable, scalable solutions.

positions.title: Artificial Intelligence Solution Architect III
positions.description:
• Architect and develop enterprise AI applications and agentic platforms spanning generative AI, RAG, APIs, data services, real-time interaction, and modern application architectures.
• Engineer conversational and voice AI capabilities using speech-to-text, contextual retrieval, streaming agent responses, text-to-speech, and LiveKit to support real-time human-to-AI interaction.
• Develop AI-driven simulation and wargaming solutions incorporating configurable AI personas, persona-aware retrieval, persistent session context, role handoffs, and synthetic-media technologies.
• Lead full-stack delivery across React and TypeScript interfaces, FastAPI backend services, PostgreSQL persistence, REST APIs, automated testing, and end-to-end application troubleshooting.
• Design observability architectures for Kubernetes-hosted AI platforms using OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus/Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Alloy.
• Evaluate emerging AI technologies and platform capabilities across agent frameworks, deployment architecture, security, scalability, observability, and enterprise integration.
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Generative AI · AI Solution Architecture · Agentic AI Development · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · Large Language Models (LLMs)

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed, developed, and deployed highly scalable applications using Microservices architecture on AWS, supporting 10 million daily active users with high availability and fault tolerance.
•	Architect and implement microservices solutions processing over $2B in annual transactions using Java, SpringBoot, Python, and AWS cloud infrastructure.
•	Built responsive single-page applications using React, JavaScript (ES6+), Next.js, Typescript, and Node.js, ensuring cross-browser compatibility and optimal user experience.
•	Migrated legacy data to distributed systems with Kafka Stream, ensuring integrity and stability.
•	Increased test coverage from 60% to 95% using TDD (Jest, JUnit, Mockito) and built a Gatling framework that revealed scaling bottlenecks, boosting throughput by 45% and cutting manual testing by 50%.
•	Accelerated refactoring and bug resolution using AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Built backend services handling secure payment processing, including credit card and ACH bank transfer integrations, ensuring PCI compliance and transaction integrity.
•	Designed and deployed highly scalable microservices on AWS using Java and Spring Boot, integrating with Kafka for real-time event processing and PostgreSQL for transactional data storage.
•	Converted monolithic applications to event-driven Microservices architecture applications using Hibernate, Kafka Stream, Docker, Kubernetes, and Jenkins, increasing performance and scalability.
•	Improved deployment frequency by 40% through automated testing and CI/CD/CT pipelines.
•	Collaborated with cross-functional teams to refine backlogs, improve system architecture, and reduce technical debt. 
•	Optimized performance and scalability of mobile and web applications handling terabytes of data daily, ensuring high availability in a fast-paced, hyper-growth environment.
•	Deployed Dockerized applications to AWS EKS on EC2, leveraging Kubernetes orchestration to enhance scalability, reliability, and security.
•	Gained experience with GCP solutions, including BigQuery and Data Mesh architecture, streamlining data processing workflows.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Architected internal and client facing applications using Java/JEE, Maven, Spring Framework, Microservices architecture, Flutter, Dart, Gradle, GitHub, TypeScript, JavaScript, Jquery, HTML, CSS. 
•	Built backend services handling secure financial Transactions via RESTful APIs, Spring Boot, React, Hibernate, MySQL, Oracle PL/SQL, Azure and other technologies. 
•	Built CI/CD /CT pipeline with Gatling, Terrafrom, Cucumber, Docker and GitHub Actions, enhancing development speed by 75%.
•	Mentor and guide 12+ junior engineers through structured learning programs, resulting in 4 promotions and 30% improvement in team productivity.
•	Led a team of 10 engineers, enhancing system performance, achieving 99.99% uptime and reducing project turnaround times by 25%.
•	Designed PostgreSQL and MySQL relational schemas to support financial transaction workflows.
•	Developed a data ingestion application with Apache Spark Stream and Kafka for transferring data to MariaDB, improving efficiency by 30%
•	Manage stakeholders’ communication to define and achieve business SLA/SLO.
•	Utilized development methodologies such as Waterfall, Agile, BDD, and TDD.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Created and modified new clients’ platform application that helped company exceed project earnings by 30%.
•	Developed and maintained e-commerce search and merchandising platform supporting peak traffic of 10,000 requests per second with a 99.99% uptime SLA, platform processing 500M+ API calls daily using Java/JEE, C#, .NET, Flutter, Dart, MySQL, modern JavaScript,  Jquery, HTML, and SASS.
•	Implemented distributed caching solutions with Redis and Elasticsearch, reducing query response times by 70% during peak load.
•	Created high-performance ETL pipelines using Hadoop ecosystem technologies for product catalog management, ensuring data consistency across a distributed environment.
•	Mentored 6 junior developers, resulting in 35% improvement in their productivity and code quality.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed HIPAA-compliant healthcare applications integrating with Epic EHR system, ensuring secure patient data handling using Java, C#, .NET, SQL, Oracle, modern JavaScript, Jquery, Json, HTML, and CSS.
•	Refactor code which increased the stability of 10 apps by 50%.
•	Built real-time patient monitoring dashboard reducing critical response time by 30%.
•	Developed data processing systems for clinical research projects, enhancing data accuracy.
•	Documented features, technical specifications, and infrastructure requirements.
•	Built and maintained complex queries in SQL and Oracle using PL/SQL.
•	Managed and mentored developer team and provided training to improve their skill performance.
•	Established continuous integration and continuous deployment practices.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Created responsive web applications and data-driven solutions for conference management.
•	Developed web and mobile applications using Java/ JEE, JSP, SQL, XML, HTML, JQuery, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and CSS. 
•	Initialized clusters, created databases (catalogs), schemas and tables.
•	Assisted with deploying applications on Apache Tomcat.
•	Implemented unit testing with JUnit and improved legacy code performance.
•	Consulted with clients to gather and determine user needs and design solutions.
•	Implemented client side validations using JavaScript, JQuery, and JSP.
•	Collaborated with a team of 20 developers to create a scalable e-commerce platform that supporting a million daily active users.
•	Worked in a UNIX/Linux environment to monitor logs, create scripts, manage configurations, execute files, and perform testing and maintenance.
